note: The boundary file and the architecture config file. A change to this file needs the human principal's approval. Every entry carries a reason. The keys are the sections the architecture-guardrails skill names: sensitivePaths is its sensitive paths section and restrictedImports its restricted imports section; add its other sections as this repository needs them.

sensitivePathsEntryForm.path: <a file or glob inside the security boundary>
sensitivePathsEntryForm.reason: <what crosses a scope if this file is wrong>

allowed: <a glob of files allowed to import it>
<restricted dependency>.reason: <why only these files may hold it>
